title: Tech Tattva Academic Year 2026-27 Kickoff Recap
summary: Thank you to all 150+ students who attended our annual orientation session in the KMCE Auditorium.
content: Our annual club orientation session was a tremendous success with over 150 enthusiastic students participating. We presented our upcoming roadmap for the semester, including upcoming hackathons, weekly peer mentorship tracks, and guest lectures from industry professionals.

title: Weekly Peer Coding Sessions Every Friday
summary: Join us every Friday from 4:30 PM to 6:00 PM in Computer Lab 1 for collaborative coding sessions.
content: Tech Tattva is initiating weekly informal Code Jam sessions every Friday evening. Whether you are working on a personal web project, practicing LeetCode, or looking for team members for hackathons, drop by Lab 1 to connect with fellow student developers.
